title: On Loving Birds
text:
Title: On Loving Birds

I love birds, man. I love birds so much that my hardwired fear of rodents is eclipsed by my love 
for them. Now, that’s deep, faithful, and abiding love—because rodents have snouts and tails 
that make me want to freeze mid-jump until they’ve scurried several zip codes away. 
You may wonder how I came to this realization. I’ll tell you. One time, a barred owl came 
into the Wild Bird Fund with head trauma. I was tasked with feeding the poor guy. So, 
I cut up three baby mice, thinking the entire time, “Hantavirus, hantavirus; dear God, 
not me in close proximity 
to hantavirus!” Blame my father for my neuroses. He’s a microbiologist.
